summary: OCHA reports two Palestinians injured when settlers stoned Palestinian vehicles on 19 and 27 March; the Mar. 19 Al-Maarajat component is already canonical, while the remaining Deir Istiya component requires exact matching.
discovery_sources: OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; NAD Daily Situation Report Mar 27 2023; NAD March 2023 monthly monitoring; prior canonical ILPV-2023-0323
resolution_notes: Historical recheck materially narrowed the remaining component. NAD's Mar. 27 daily report identifies the Deir Istiya victim as Muhammad Sami Muhammad Abu Rabi', a Balata-camp resident, and says settlers stoned citizens' vehicles at 13:50 near Deir Istiya, injuring him and leading to treatment at Nablus government hospital. NAD's monthly chronology places the event on Mar. 26, while OCHA's aggregate assigns the second vehicle-stoning injury to Mar. 27. Because that one-day chronology conflict remains and no independent exact-event media/corroboration beyond the official Palestinian monitoring lane was recovered, the event remains Unresolved. The Mar. 19 component remains deduplicated to ILPV-2023-0323.
media_status: No exact original incident media recovered; no generic or merely related imagery used.
